title: Bitcoin Crashes as the US Govt Sells: Where Does the Crash Stop?
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: ~800 seized BTC ($71M) moved to Coinbase Prime triggered panic and ~$500M long liquidations, possibly a court-ordered return rather than a sale.
Clusters of short liquidations above price act as magnets that could squeeze Bitcoin higher.
Coins on low-revenue chains (TIA, Sonic, Story, Scroll, Manta etc.) will trend down long term; only short them.

calls.condition: Bearish only on a confirmed close below the ~80,000-80,600 support zone (Nov wick to May high), not on wicks.
calls.reason: Correction landed on long-watched support plus the 0.382 fib; bearish crowd piling into shorts with liquidations near 84,675 that could squeeze price up.
calls.quote: right around 84675, looks like some traders might need to be humbled

calls.condition: Interested in a long only at the ascending trend line (~67 as transcribed), not before.
calls.reason: Ascending trend line from two pivots that other coins already tagged.
calls.quote: I'm still watching this area for a long. I'm not really interested in longing before that level

calls.reason: Short opened off a horizontal level/liquidation cluster; currently a little in profit.
calls.quote: we're short near and right now a little bit in profit.

calls.reason: Long off the ascending trend line that held the 11 p.m. dump wick; watching 4h descending trend line area for more longs and has add orders below.
calls.quote: So, I'm watching this area for a potential XRP long.

calls.condition: Losing the trend-line support (from November) would open a drop; repeated tests raise breakdown risk.
calls.reason: Price touching long-term trend-line support; 'the more you knock on the door' the likelier it breaks.
calls.quote: This is an area for support. I would be watching on SUI.

calls.reason: Low chain revenue; such coins trend down long term, so only short, never long.
calls.quote: these are going to long-term trend downward. So yeah, if you're going to trade it, I'm looking at a short.

calls.reason: Lost its trend line after rejecting resistance; first support is a recent weak pivot low.
calls.quote: Now it does look like it lost this trend line

calls.reason: Posted short at 218 (read as $2.18) on descending trend line + 0.786 fib confluence; the trade worked but he closed it early.
calls.quote: I gave you a level to short 218.

calls.condition: If DOGE falls further (~16% over the next week) to the Feb 6 pivot low / double-factor support, he would look to go long.
calls.reason: Already down ~10% in two days; double-factor support below makes a long better than a short.
calls.quote: I wouldn't recommend shorting it... yeah, I would be looking to long Doge everybody.

notes: Date: no spoken date; he says the show airs 1:30 p.m. ET daily and the BTC drop/government-transfer news ('11 pm last night') matches Gareth Soloway's Wed 2026-10-07 stream, so dated 2026-10-07 (listing approx_date 2026-10-08 from '21 hours ago' looks a day late).
